positions.title: Senior Product Developer
positions.description:
Developed and maintained BMC’s Business Service Assurance and Event Management software products. Highlights include:
- The rewrite of some command line interfaces for BMC Event Management to facilitate their   maintenance.
- The port of the BMC ProactiveNet Performance Management Suite to Linux Red Hat
- The dedicated support for critical customer issues as a member of the Customer Engineering team.

Ported  the BMC Performance Manager WebSphere Business Integration product (PATROL MQ km) to the iSeries (AS/400) platform.  Was the key developer for this product for several  years  responsible for its enhancements and maintenance on all its supported platforms: Unix, Linux, Windows, and iSeries. 

Implemented enhancements into the BMC Performance Manager Text Log Monitor product.

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description:
Was the consultant assigned to IBM’s AS/400 Branch to provide Level 3 support for:
- The System Distribution Directory component of the operating system (OS/400).
- The Domino for AS/400 Server Mail services (SMTP) feature.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on the Backup and Recovery component of the OS/400 providing:
- Quality assurance for the Save and Restore commands.
- Level 3 support for the Reclaim storage component.
